scope.codeGraphTool: Not available in this environment; equivalent coverage obtained via 7 parallel read-only research agents (Explore subagent) doing Read+Grep over the scoped directories, each producing route->service->prisma edge tables and direct-Prisma-access-site inventories for one domain cluster. See methodology note below.

methodology: This map was produced by 7 parallel read-only research passes, each scoped to one domain cluster (Appointments/Scheduling; Patients/Privacy/Platform-Admin/Security/Audit; Messaging & Communication Channels; Billing/Treatment/Finance/Insurance; Imaging/Attachments/Inventory/Labs; External Calendar/Backup/Reporting/Org/Auth-Users-Settings; Frontend->Backend coupling). Each pass read the actual source files (not just grep) and cross-referenced outside its own slice for inbound edges. Trivial same-domain CRUD is grouped rather than itemized per the task's 'no broad dump' instruction; every cross-domain, tenant-ambiguous, or transaction-integrity-relevant call site is itemized individually.

securityFollowUpValidationSequence.note: These are VALIDATION TASKS, not accepted implementation tasks. No remediation code was written or is authorized by this evidence. Each item asks a future task to confirm/deny a CODE_PATH_CONFIRMED or UNVERIFIED_INFERENCE finding above with behavioral or production evidence, and only then decide a fix. F2-PREP-005 (Consolidated Modularization Charter) will triage which of these are immediate pre-F2 blockers, F2 pilot prerequisites, or normal remediation backlog — this task does not make that triage call.

sequence.title: Legacy WhatsApp getDefaultClinic tenant-resolution validation
sequence.validates: Whether a caller holding only the shared WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (no org-specific credential) can in fact create/cancel/read appointment-request data for a clinic other than the database's first-ever-created one, and whether the Evolution webhook's missing per-tenant HMAC is independently exploitable. Currently CODE_PATH_CONFIRMED only — no behavioral reproduction or production evidence exists yet.

sequence.title: WhatsApp/Instagram inbox appointment concurrency-path validation
sequence.validates: Whether two concurrent requests against routes/whatsappInbox.ts or routes/instagramInbox.ts's create-appointment endpoint can in fact double-book the same practitioner/slot, given the missing advisory lock. Currently CODE_PATH_CONFIRMED only — no concurrent-load reproduction has been executed.

sequence.title: Backup/restore RBAC and tenant-scope validation
sequence.validates: Locate the HTTP route(s) that call services/backupService.ts's runBackup/runRestoreTest, confirm what RBAC middleware (if any) gates them, and confirm whether passwordStepUp-style step-up auth is applied. Currently UNVERIFIED_INFERENCE — this is the lowest-confidence finding in the top-8 Critical list precisely because the calling route was never located.

sequence.title: Patient anonymization atomicity and failure-recovery validation
sequence.validates: Whether a simulated failure partway through services/privacy/patientAnonymization.ts's 12+-step sequence (or the data-retention job's live-run sweep) leaves the database in the documented inconsistent state, and what recovery/detection currently exists (if any) for that state. Currently CODE_PATH_CONFIRMED only — no failure-injection test has been run.

sequence.title: Financial transaction atomicity validation
sequence.validates: Whether a simulated crash/failure between the sequential writes in the installment-payoff and practitioner-payout create/delete paths produces the documented orphaned-payment / stuck-plan / dangling-payout states, and whether any existing reconciliation job would catch it. Currently CODE_PATH_CONFIRMED only — no failure-injection test has been run.
